info.title: Gobusgo operational API
info.summary: The operational HTTP endpoints of Gobusgo.
info.description: The liveness and readiness checks, `GET /health` and `GET /ready`, for the image's health check and the deploy. The public endpoints are in `openapi.json`. Every error is RFC 9457 problem details. This document is maintained by hand and a test checks only that its operations match the router, not that bodies match its schemas.

servers.description: The origin the document is read from.

get.summary: Check that the server is running
get.description: A liveness check that reads nothing beyond the server itself. It is not logged.

get.summary: Check that the views are full
get.description: Reads the views and starts no fetch. It is not logged. The tile archive never changes the status.

200.description: The views hold what a start fills them with. `application/json; charset=utf-8`.

503.description: The views are still filling. The body is the problem details object with the tile fields beside it, `application/problem+json; charset=utf-8`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the request is repeated.

NotAcceptable.description: The `Accept` header names no JSON media type. The body is problem details as `application/problem+json; charset=utf-8`, except that a request that accepts HTML first is answered with an HTML error page.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem details object. `type` is always `about:blank`, so `title` is the HTTP reason phrase of `status`.

title.description: The reason phrase of `status`, such as `Not Found`.

detail.description: Present only where the application writes the explanation itself; the message of an unexpected error never appears.

revision.description: The full commit the application was built from, present where the build names one.

tiles.description: The freshness of the route and stop tile archive.

tilesAgeSeconds.description: The archive's age where its name holds its build time; absent for `none` and for an archive whose name holds none.

NotReady.description: A problem details object with `tiles` and `tilesAgeSeconds` beside it.

tiles.description: The freshness of the route and stop tile archive.

tilesAgeSeconds.description: The archive's age where its name holds its build time; absent for `none` and for an archive whose name holds none.
